title: End-to-End Proof Convergence
problem: The six proof upgrades are individually frozen, but without one terminal composition gate the architecture can still drift into a state where every piece exists while the complete proof chain is no longer jointly certifiable.
root_cause: API2 had no final read-only convergence layer that requires the complete Step-1-through-Step-6 local contract chain and the authoritative frozen-registry chain to agree before architecture closeout.
patch: Add a read-only Step-7 convergence validator plus a permanent GitHub workflow. It verifies all six prior ledgers/plans/engines/workflows, requires all six authoritative frozen checkpoints, verifies the candidate head against the frozen registry, and then uses the normal exact-head plus merged-main proof chain for final closeout.

repair.evidence: MONSTER Anti-Loop V2 replay was GREEN; Action Ledger V2 then failed closed because the new Step-7 task ledger did not include the required action_log object.
repair.patch: Add only the required genesis action_log envelope to the Step-7 task ledger. No runtime, model, projection, market, registry-engine, or prior-step artifact is modified.
